About

[edit]

The Coupe de France Slash is a Rocket League 3v3 competition organized by NEO (formerly organized by Webedia) mostly for French players and French teams. See the Eligibility section for more details about it.

Eligibility

[edit]
  • Team rosters for each match must maintain, at all times, at least two (2) Players on its roster that are French.
  • If a team doesn’t respect the previous requirement, this team must be a French company in order to participate.

Format

[edit]
  • League Play - November 2nd - 11th, 2026
    • Double Round Robin Bo5 (each team plays 10 series).
    • Top 4 advances to Playoffs.


  • Playoffs - November 12th, 2026
    • Single Elimination Bracket Bo7.
